title: Sweetcorn, Cherry Tomato and Rocket Pizza with Crème Fraîche
changes_from_base: A basil and chilli crème fraîche spread replaces the tomato sauce, fontina melts over sweetcorn, cherry tomatoes and shallot, and a pile of lightly dressed rocket goes on after baking.
summary: Sheet pizza with a creamy herbed base, melted cheese, juicy corn kernels and charred cherry tomatoes, crowned with peppery rocket at the last moment.
equipment: rimmed baking tray, about 30 x 40 cm

ingredients.item: pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature
sweetcorn kernels, cut from 1 cob (or thawed frozen)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat Oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 260 °C with a shelf in the middle and brush the tray with 15 ml oil.

steps.title: Mix Base
steps.text: Combine crème fraîche (120 g), basil (4 tbsp chopped) and chilli flakes (¼ tsp) in a bowl.

steps.title: Shape Dough
steps.text: Roll the dough (450 g) on a lightly floured worktop to about 40 x 25 cm and 6 mm thick, lift onto the tray and brush the edges with 10 ml oil.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread the crème fraîche mixture leaving a 1 cm border, scatter fontina (225 g grated), quartered tomatoes (170 g), sweetcorn kernels (120 g), thinly sliced shallot (1) and salt (¼ tsp).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 15-20 min, turning halfway, until golden with browned spots.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Cool 5 min, toss baby rocket (55 g) with the last 5 ml oil, pile over the pizza and slice.

tips: If using frozen sweetcorn, thaw and dry the kernels thoroughly to prevent releasing excess moisture onto the pizza
Scatter the rocket just before serving so it remains crisp and vibrant rather than wilting into the warm cheese
Slice the shallot paper-thin so it caramelises evenly during baking instead of staying raw or tough
storage: Eat straight away for best results; leftovers can be chilled for up to 2 days and reheated gently in a low oven if desired. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
